title: Happy Horse 1.0: Unified Video and Audio Generation Model
summary: A 15-billion parameter multimodal model from Alibaba that generates high-quality video and synchronized audio simultaneously. It features phoneme-level lip-sync and 1080p resolution optimized for production-ready content.
research_notes: Utilizes a unified single-stream Transformer architecture; supports native lip-sync in over 7 languages including English, Mandarin, and Japanese.

evolution.summary: Initially appearing anonymously as a top-ranked model on global leaderboards in April 2026, it was revealed as an Alibaba project and transitioned to full commercial availability in May 2026.
